bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-cfc999ac-20261115"
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 60
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
rows="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT chat_id FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' AND state IN ('verified','published') ORDER BY chat_id" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 61
FLAGS="$(printf '%s\n' "$rows" | python3 -c 'import sys; ids={int(x.strip()) for x in sys.stdin if x.strip()};print((1 if -1003847210571 in ids else 0)+(2 if -1002373696859 in ids else 0)+(4 if -1003770334893 in ids else 0))')"
test "$FLAGS" = 7 && { echo POSTING_PANEL_ROWS=3_OF_3; exit 0; }
echo POSTING_PANEL_MAP_INCOMPLETE
exit $((100+FLAGS))
